design.scope: Final development cycle, with fresh noise/location seeds after Gaussian-only and diffuse-mixture prototypes failed a smooth-thinning trial. The final model adds an exponential core and sparse Dirichlet weights; priors are fixed across scenarios and eruptions. These are development tests, not external validation or full-prior simulation-based calibration.
design.truth_integrals: Analytically normalized spherical fields for two added cases. Original four cases use an equal-area chart; omitted infinite-plane mass beyond 2R is <1e-80 of the volume.
design.hidden_cap: The added positive compact proximal cap is exactly zero at every observed site. Its volume is not identifiable from those observations.

prior.name: baseline
prior.kernel_weights: Symmetric Dirichlet(total concentration kernel_concentration) over Gaussian, exponential, power components, shared across fans
prior.noise: HalfNormal(noise_scale); broad-error fraction Beta(1,9), fourfold residual SD
prior.interpretation: Proper modelling assumptions, not extra observations or geological facts. Identical prior specification for every eruption.

volume.interpretation: 95% equal-tailed Bayesian credible interval conditional on this likelihood, prior and field family. Includes parameter and fan uncertainty; excludes unknown systematic preservation, sampling and source-attribution bias. Not dense-rock equivalent or ignimbrite volume.

diagnostics.interpretation: Rank-normalized split R-hat and bulk/tail ESS across independent chains. Fan labels are exchangeable; field and volume diagnostics are used instead. Passing diagnostics does not prove global mode exploration or model correctness.
diagnostics.assessment: R-hat <1.01, bulk/tail ESS >=400, zero divergences, every chain's energy BFMI >=0.3. Maximum-depth saturation is a separate efficiency warning.
